One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 754 pays 12818 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. A willow of doubt is healthy, a pearl of proof is required, and a quartz of patience is the price of a clean panel. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
